title: Tent: Fully Test-time Adaptation by Entropy Minimization
mechanism: Minimises prediction entropy by updating BN affine parameters while using test-batch statistics.
adaptation: Run with batch = one E1 module (or one cell), BN affine only. It is the canonical baseline and closes the thesis question that was dropped by expectation.
min_experiment: Arm: Tent on FINAL and SUP100-PF. Baseline: no TTA. Benchmark row; record whether crack recall collapses on E1 and test.
evidence: R: gains on CIFAR-C/ImageNet-C and on GTA-to-Cityscapes segmentation (numbers not retrieved). SGP-TTA reports Tent falling from 85.56 to 62.67 Dice on a thin-structure set where the source model was already good.
prior_overlap: Never run (handbook doc 20: dropped by expectation). BN-statistics adaptation (T9, BN-HC) failed, which supports a low score but does not close entropy updates.
